definitions.explanation: The business of selling goods directly to consumers, as opposed to wholesale trade. Includes shops, department stores, supermarkets, and online retailers.

examples.japanese: {小売業|こうりぎょう}の{売上|うりあげ}が{伸|の}びている。
{小売業|こうりぎょう}は{消費者|しょうひしゃ}のニーズに{敏感|びんかん}でなければならない。
examples.english: The retail business must be sensitive to consumer needs.

examples.japanese: ネット{通販|つうはん}の{台頭|たいとう}で{従来|じゅうらい}の{小売業|こうりぎょう}は{大|おお}きな{影響|えいきょう}を{受|う}けている。
examples.english: The rise of online shopping is having a major impact on traditional retail businesses.

notes:
USAGE:
A standard business and economics term. Used in news, business reports, and industry classifications.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {小売業|こうりぎょう}{者|しゃ} (retailer)
- {小売業|こうりぎょう}{界|かい} (retail industry)
- {大手|おおて}{小売業|こうりぎょう} (major retail business)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {卸売業|おろしうりぎょう}: wholesale trade — selling in bulk to retailers rather than consumers
- {小売|こうり}: retail — the shorter form without 業
